A.text: Deep sedation or general anesthesia requires an ECG monitor and defibrillator beyond the moderate sedation equipment, so additional equipment is needed.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: BEST PRACTICE › Deep sedation/General anesthesia

B.text: Beyond moderate sedation equipment, deep sedation or general anesthesia requires a pediatric-capable ECG monitor and a defibrillator that are readily available.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: BEST PRACTICE › Deep sedation/General anesthesia

C.text: The requirement includes a defibrillator as well as the ECG monitor.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: BEST PRACTICE › Deep sedation/General anesthesia

D.text: The defibrillator must be readily available, not summoned after an arrest has occurred.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: BEST PRACTICE › Deep sedation/General anesthesia

explanation.text: Deep sedation and general anesthesia need a pediatric-capable ECG monitor and a readily available defibrillator in addition to moderate sedation equipment.
